label: first copy-phase step after <DEL> in long sequences starting with i/d
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit that fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely (99.8% of mass) on the step right after <DEL> (recall_idx 1), where the model is fed back original token 0 and outputs token 1. Nearly all activation (93%) occurs when that token, i.e. the first original token, is i or d, and it is strongly length-dependent: L=9 holds 90% of mass, L=8 9%, L=7 1%, and it never fires for L<=6. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases. Precision is low: only about 1 in 4 L=9 sequences starting with i/d activate it. The identity of the second original token (output token) modulates it somewhat (h, d, l, b, r, s favored), but adding a token list improves F1 only modestly and looks like lookup overfitting. Rare off-pattern firings occur for first tokens m, w, l, 0.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=d (+5.82), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=i (+3.92), t=10 & in_tok=m (+2.60), phase=2 & in_tok=i (+2.23), phase=2 & out_tok=h (+1.82), phase=2 & out_tok=r (+1.71).
